ns2:course.label: ABE Principles: Bioprocessing
ns2:course.description: Principles of bioprocess engineering applied to food and agricultural products: material balances; fluid flow; heat and mass transfers; drying; evaporation; fermentation; distillation; process simulation. Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr Engineering & Agr Science or Agricultural & Biological Engr major(s).
